private._note: vLLM / llama.cpp server: start with a context of at least 16384 tokens (vLLM --max-model-len, llama.cpp -c).

qwen3._note: Self-hosted Qwen3 on vLLM (runpod/setup.sh): vllm serve <model> --max-model-len 32768 --reasoning-parser qwen3. QWEN_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1, QWEN_KEY = the --api-key (any text if none). chat_model must equal the served model: runpod/env.sh sets CALLGUARD_QWEN_MODEL, see README. Thinking needs room: max_output_tokens covers reasoning + JSON. Qwen recommends temperature 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 for thinking models (greedy decoding loops).

qwen3_fast._note: Hybrid Qwen3 (8B/14B/32B, AWQ ok) with thinking switched off: faster, for 24 GB GPUs and quick iterations.

ollama._note: Start Ollama with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=16384 (or more): the OpenAI-compatible endpoint ignores per-request context settings and silently truncates long prompts. If the server rejects json_schema, set json_mode to json_object.

ollama_qwen3._note: Laptop development only (slow on CPU). Start Ollama with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768.

speaches._note: Self-hosted Whisper (faster-whisper) behind an OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions, e.g. the speaches server. For Swiss German, a Swiss German fine-tune of Whisper (outputs Standard German) can be served the same way.

whisper_local._note: Any self-hosted OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions server (speaches, faster-whisper-server) on its own port, e.g. WHISPER_URL=http://localhost:8001/v1, so it can run beside vLLM on 8000. Set CALLGUARD_ASR=whisper_local. A Swiss German Whisper fine-tune (CTranslate2 format) can be served instead; set WHISPER_MODEL to its name.
